prohibited_inferences: Do not treat the v11 extension or PC-13 fixture as evidence about a named institution system expert model or source.
Do not infer source independence from citation speaker expert agent or document counts.
Do not infer model or corpus diversity from multiple personas agents interfaces or organizational labels.
Do not infer corroboration from repeated claims or derivative reporting.
Do not infer evidence validity from source diversity independence or presentation polish.
Do not infer the absence of counterevidence from its absence in a ranked summarized retrieved or context-limited decision surface.
Do not infer low evidence quality from minority status unpopularity or small group size.
Do not infer the correct proposal version truth consensus collective agreement or public authorization from a correct family-level majority.
Do not infer manipulation intent legitimacy or public injury from evidence dependence suppression integrity failure or reference error alone.
Do not treat the thirteen-control floor as exhaustive of every epistemic constitutional social or performative failure mode.

interpretation_contract.what_this_is: A compositional successor floor that preserves the qualified twelve-control v10 base and adds PC-13 epistemic diversity source independence evidence integrity counterevidence visibility minority correction and proposal-version equifinality without rewriting the frozen base controls.
interpretation_contract.what_this_is_not: A real-world evidence audit truth verdict consensus finding collective-agreement finding public-authorization verdict named-system allegation or complete universal theory of epistemic quality and knowledge production.
interpretation_contract.copy_ready_caveat: Preference Custody floor v11 composes the qualified v10 controls with PC-13. It separates citation and speaker counts from source roots independence clusters model and corpus lineage integrity inspection visibility minority correction and exact proposal-version consequence under one majority, while requiring real cases to preserve complete evidence dependency outcome counterfactual correction and authority custody.
